title: 第三章 结交黑熊精第四章 五毒道人
slug: 西游从蜈蚣精到百目真君
content_zh:
斗姆元君的身影消散之后，黄花洞前沉寂了片刻，随即人群渐渐松动。
有人起身就走，有人还在原地打坐回味，也有人三三两两凑到一处，低声交流着听道的心得。
洞口的星光依旧璀璨，但那股笼罩全场的古老威压已经散去。
空气重新流动起来，山风裹着夜露的凉意拂过开阔地。
吴耀从青石上站起身来，活动了一下筋骨。
此刻非但不觉得疲惫，反而神清气爽，浑身上下说不出的通透。
他感受着体内那股凝实了许多的妖力，正打算转身下山，目光扫过人群时，忽然顿了一下。
他看见了那个黑熊精。
黑熊精站在右侧妖修聚集的那片区域，身形魁梧，比周围的人妖都高出一大截。
他穿着一身粗布黑袍，腰间扎着一条不知什么野兽的皮做的腰带，脚上踏着一双草鞋，从头到脚透着一股山野粗犷之气。
但仔细看他的脸。
浓眉大眼，鼻直口方，一双眼睛亮得惊人，眼底深处藏着一股与粗犷外表截然不同的专注和思索。
他正独自站在人群边缘，抱着胳膊，低着头，嘴里念念有词，似乎还在反复咀嚼斗姆元君讲的道法。
周围的小妖们吵吵嚷嚷地散去，他浑然不觉。
吴耀心里一动。
黑熊精，西牛贺洲，求仙问道。
这几个关键词凑在一起，他几乎可以断定，这就是日后黑风山黑风洞那个黑熊精。
原著里那只黑熊精可不是一般的妖怪，他住在黑风山，却不吃人不作恶，反而一心向道。
后来偷了唐僧的锦斓袈裟，与孙悟空打了数场，那黑熊精使得一杆黑缨枪，武艺精湛，肉身强横，跟猴子打得不相上下。
最后还是观音菩萨亲自出面，用禁箍收了他，带回珞珈山做了守山大神。

能被观音菩萨亲自出手收服的妖怪，岂是寻常角色？
吴耀之前就琢磨过这个道理。
西游路上被收服的妖怪，要么天赋异禀，要么背后有人。
黑熊精显然属于前者。
这家伙跟脚虽不如他百目金蜈蚣这般洪荒异种。
但也是深山老林里不知修炼了多少年的老熊，根基扎实得可怕。
再加上一心向道，心性纯粹，这等妖怪若是入了正途，前途不可限量。
他之前以为黑熊精的本事是自己修来的，现在看来不是。
这黑熊精能修到那般地步。
多半就是因为今日这场听道，得了斗姆元君的指点，打下了扎实的根基。
往后又不知从哪里得了别的机缘。
一步一个脚印，硬生生走上去的。
吴耀想到这里，目光在那七个蜘蛛精身上扫了一下。
七个女妖正互相搀扶着站起来，穿红衣的那个正笑着跟穿紫衣的说什么，声音清脆，像一串铃铛响。
她们看上去收获也不小，一个个容光焕发，周身妖气比之前纯净了许多。
吴耀犹豫了一瞬，没有过去搭话。
七个蜘蛛精日后会是他的师妹不假，但现在他主动凑上去，没名没分的，人家凭什么搭理他？
七个女子结伴而行，他一个陌生男妖上去搭讪，成什么样子。
content_en:
After Doumu Yuanjun's figure disappeared, there was silence for a moment in front of Huanghua Cave, and then the crowd gradually relaxed.
Some people got up and left, some were still sitting there meditating and reminiscing, and some people gathered together in twos and threes and exchanged their thoughts on listening to the sermon in low voices.
The starlight at the entrance of the cave was still bright, but the ancient pressure that enveloped the entire place had dissipated.
The air began to flow again, and the mountain breeze carried the coolness of night dew across the open land.
Wu Yao stood up from the bluestone and stretched his muscles.
At this moment, not only did I not feel tired, but I felt refreshed and my whole body felt indescribably clear.
He felt the much condensed demon power in his body, and was about to turn around and go down the mountain. When his eyes swept across the crowd, he suddenly paused.
He saw the black bear spirit.
The black bear spirit stood in the area on the right where the demon cultivators gathered. He was tall and taller than the surrounding human demons.
He wore a coarse black robe, with a belt made of the skin of an unknown beast tied around his waist, and a pair of straw sandals on his feet. He exuded a rough and rough atmosphere from head to toe.
But look closely at his face.
He has thick eyebrows and big eyes, a straight nose and a square mouth. His eyes are astonishingly bright, and deep in his eyes there is concentration and thinking that is completely different from his rough appearance.
He was standing alone on the edge of the crowd, with his arms folded and his head lowered, muttering something in his mouth, as if he was still chewing on the Taoism taught by Lord Doumu Yuan.
The little monsters around him dispersed noisily, and he didn't notice it at all.
Wu Yao's heart moved.
Black Bear Spirit, Xiniu Hezhou, asked for immortality.
Putting these keywords together, he could almost conclude that this was the black bear spirit from Batu Caves in Batu Mountain in the future.
The black bear spirit in the original book is not an ordinary monster. He lives in Black Wind Mountain, but he does not eat people or do evil. Instead, he wholeheartedly pursues the Tao.
Later, he stole Tang Monk's brocade cassock and fought with Sun Wukong several times. The black bear spirit used a black tassel spear, which was superb in martial arts and physically strong, and could fight as well as a monkey.
In the end, Guanyin Bodhisattva came forward in person, captured him with a restraint, and took him back to Luojia Mountain to become the guardian of the mountain.
How can a monster that can be subdued by Guanyin Bodhisattva himself be an ordinary character?
Wu Yao had pondered this truth before.
The monsters that were subdued on the journey to the west were either extremely talented or had someone behind them.
Black Bear Spirit obviously belongs to the former.
Although this guy's heels and feet are not as good as the hundred-eyed golden centipede, it's a primitive species.
But he is also an old bear who has practiced for countless years in the deep mountains and forests, and his foundation is terrifyingly solid.
Coupled with the fact that they are dedicated to the Tao and have a pure mind, if these monsters enter the right path, their future is limitless.
He used to think that the black bear spirit's abilities were acquired by himself, but now it seems that is not the case.
This black bear spirit can cultivate to that extent.
It was probably because of today's sermon hearing and the guidance of Doumu Yuanjun that a solid foundation was laid.
Later, I don’t know where I got another opportunity.
Step by step, step by step, forcefully walked up.
Wu Yao thought of this and glanced at the seven spider spirits.
The seven banshees were helping each other to stand up. The one in red was smiling and saying something to the one in purple. Her voice was as clear and clear as a string of bells.
They seemed to have gained quite a lot. They were all radiant, and their demonic aura was much purer than before.
Wu Yao hesitated for a moment and did not go over to talk.
It is true that the seven spider spirits will be his junior sisters in the future, but now he has taken the initiative to join in. They have no name or status, so why should they pay attention to him?
Seven women were walking together, and he was approached by a strange male demon to strike up a conversation.
